answer: Do not open a new position. The bounce sits inside space, the weakest of the 29 baskets, and long-duration growth carries the regime's worst fit while the stock remains below its 200-day average.
departure: The space basket is Underweight, which implies Trim for a holder; for new money the verdict is Avoid because the registered verdict already sized it as a pass and nothing since has cleared its gates.

why.macro_fit: Long-duration growth, the archetype most exposed to rising real and long yields, so the regime is a direct headwind.
why.theme_price: Down sharply over three months and more than half off its 52-week high, back above its 50-day but below its 200-day average, inside a space basket in downtrend.
why.allowlist: Attention is heating but small, three accounts and all long, with recent tone slightly negative (posts 2101177184463523985, 2102550672738766885).
why.record: The 2026-09-24 runway probe rated it one_leg_missing, failing the insider gate; the registered verdict was a pass, with the kill test of Neutron not on the pad by 2026-12-31, not yet hit.

changes.tell: CPI: a soft core print that pulls the 10-year back below 4.75% would lift the long-duration cap and the space basket with it.
Neutron on the pad by year end, with the stock retaking its 200-day average, would reopen the case; missing it fires the kill.
